results.name: Flood In Ecuador
results.reason: On the 26 February 2025 at 16 :00 UTC, heavy rainfall affected western and coastal Ecuador causing floods and triggering landslides. The event is on-going, causing significant damage. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide damage assesment emergency mapping.
